note: Moves session_end_time off LensLlmInputs and adds it as end_time on SessionMetadata.
Adds a note distinguishing paged settings from oracle.py's bounded ones, renames to _PAGED_MEMBER_SETTINGS, and caps the paged read by raising the existing OracleSetTooLarge.
Adds a lib column and a dedicated max limit constant; the query tagging feature at the commented line is unchanged.
Extracts CSV export helpers, action, selector and listener from membersLogic into a new membersExportLogic.
Drops the local ingestionLimits helper and uses billingLogic.isProductOverUsageLimit for events and recordings.
Replaces inline string/text-item checks with the shared extractTextContent util and a small helper predicate.
Removes schedule sync from HogFlow post_save and adds a post_save receiver on HogFlowSchedule that syncs next run.
Extracts _validate_batch_inputs and calls it from both prepare_capture_internal_batch and capture_batch_internal.
Renames ingestion lanes/ to pipelines/; the rasterizer stays under ingestion/pipelines/sessionreplay rather than moving out.
Renames the private helper to public apply_provisioning_defaults and imports the public name in the EE auth layer.
Handles oversized numeric flag ids without panicking; no per-team rate limiter is added.
Splits assign into MessageGroup, WorkerAssignments and group_messages_by_routing_key with new unit tests for the pieces.
Removes schedules from HogFlow serializers and create/update, adds separate schedules list/create and detail patch/delete actions.
Rewrites the autonomy viewset into SignalTeamConfigViewSet, dropping the redundant get_serializer_context team override.
Only rewrites the explanatory comment on the separate exclude filter step; the step remains separate.
Adds DeltaTableHelper.run_maintenance returning one vacuum version; pre-write function calls it once and is the sole watermark writer.
Collapses both sanitize functions into a shared _sanitize core with partials per validator and a shared error-code extractor.
Removes the custom isFormValid selector and uses the kea-forms notificationFormHasErrors in the dialog.
Moves the MGET batch size constant into gemini_cleanup_sweep.constants as MGET_BATCH_SIZE and imports it.
Handles oversized numeric flag ids; HEAD/OPTIONS handling via the sibling non-GET handler is not added.
